design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and function-first. High contrast with generous negative space. No unnecessary decorations, relying on tight typography and strict grid layouts. Embracing the 'Grid Borders' technical look.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The 'Grid Borders' (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton for sections like Skills and Projects. Heavy use of generous padding (p-8 to p-12) in containers. Asymmetry creates tension.

components.navigation: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-md, 1px bottom border border-border, flex justify-between items-center py-4 bg-background_primary/80
components.hero: Full height min-h-[80vh] flex flex-col justify-center. Massive typography left-aligned. Include profile image as a stark rectangular block (no rounded corners).
components.buttons: Flat solid background #0A0A0A text white, or transparent with 1px border. Hover state inverts or adds accent color. rounded-none.
components.project_card: Minimalist. Image fills the top, tight padding below for title and mono tags. rounded-none to maintain Swiss rigor. 1px solid border.
components.skills_grid: Grid layout (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4), 1px borders dividing items (border-collapse style). p-8 in each grid cell.
components.contact_section: Massive text link for email (max text-6xl). Left aligned or centered. Strict grid lines.

motion.global: Use native CSS transitions only. No external animation libraries. transition-all duration-300 ease-out.
motion.hover: Image zoom on hover (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden container. Button background inversion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts in index.html: Outfit (300, 400, 500), IBM Plex Sans (400, 500), JetBrains Mono (400).
Do NOT use any external animation libraries. Use CSS transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out for hover effects.
Ensure the hero heading does not exceed text-6xl and uses a very tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter).
Keep borders sharp. Use rounded-none for all cards, buttons, and images to enforce the Swiss design aesthetic.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
Build standard React functional components. No Shadcn needed since this is a highly custom marketing/portfolio layout. Use plain HTML/Tailwind.
Implement smooth scrolling using CSS scroll-behavior: smooth.
